N2.heard: Everything here is a software simulation. No radios, no satellite, no hardware.

N3.heard: The reactive baseline waits for its link to fail. The session goes dark, four times, 7.32 seconds.

N4.heard: Continua is the working application around that problem. Every panel reads from one engine over a live socket and the execution mode is always on screen.

N5.heard: Five steps. Observe, receiver side facts only. The controller never sees the world script.

N6.heard: Predict a short horizon on those same facts three seconds ahead.

N7.heard: Prepare. It warms cellular while Wi-Fi still carries. Steer. Six tenths of a second later.

N8.heard: Explain it records why at the moment it decided.

N9.heard: Same seed, same trace. Only the policy changed. 7.32 seconds become 0.16 and that remainder is the session starting up.

N12.heard: What Continua adds is the price, the same continuity at a third of the cost, a twelfth of the satellite data. It loses on application health.
